messages:
elaine: Heads-up from usability test: users confused by 'Perf' badge in catalog compare. Many asked if it's quality score. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/test-perf-badge.png

matt: Agreed. Recommend renaming to 'Latency' and show unit 'ms' in tooltip: 'Median latency @512 tokens (ms). Lower is better.'

rui: Also saw a visual bug: filter chips remain highlighted after closing compare. Repro: apply filters, select rows to compare, close compare, then click All models. Chips still look active but list is unfiltered.

amy: That mismatch is bad for screen readers too. VoiceOver reads chips as pressed. We should tie chip visual state strictly to applied filters. If a row is selected for compare, use a different visual (outlined chip with 'compare' label).

matt: For pinned versions, the filled-pin icon is overloaded. Proposal: use bookmark icon + tiny 'Pinned vX' label next to model name in dense rows. Keeps meaning clear.

elaine: Keyboard flow: when opening compare drawer focus should go to the drawer heading (tabindex=-1 then focus()) and trap focus (aria-modal=true). On close restore focus to last item.

rui: Quick fixes: 1) remove visual-only active class on route change; 2) change badge label and tooltip; 3) swap pin icon with bookmark and add sublabel. I'll open PR for chip + badge today.

amy: Also check tooltip contrast in dark theme; current yellow tooltip fails WCAG. I'll supply accessible tokens.

uxbot: Actions: Rui 12 PR for chip state + ARIA notes (due Mon). Amy 12 tooltip color tokens + a11y check (due Tue). Matt 12 bookmark icon mock + compact-row placement (due Tue). Elaine 12 update empty compare microcopy: 'Select up to 4 models to compare — use arrows or checkboxes.' (due Mon).

elainE: thanks all, prioritizing chip fix and latency label in next patch.
